name: Hrvoje Mišetić
biography: Hrvoje Mišetić is a Web3 auditor and security researcher at OtterSec with prior research projects including Linux kernel LPE, QEMU hypervisor escape, and browser exploitation. He is a member of the Crusaders of Rust CTF team, and DiceGang, with whom he has qualified for Defcon CTF Finals multiple times. He presented Minecraft RCE research at OffensiveCon ‘26.
